top_comments.author: @BioTechRvs
top_comments.text:
Claude has a thing called skills, also has a thing called session memory - also has a thing called .md files. 

All of which make Claude code or any agentic agent remember exactly what they are doing without having to reread anything. 

That’s why this is bullshit 😉

top_comments.author: @blackmesaarc
top_comments.text:
Wildly overestimated outcomes and simple attention grab. 

Misleading Statements, like "Claude reads your entire codebase even before you ask you first question". Even if you don't know how LLM Coding works under the hood, you at least know that THIS is not true at all.

Graphify does indeed scratch an itch, but it does not provide a substantial advantage for all workloads, the sweet spot is  narrower than you think.

It does not magically reduce your token consumption from "I need a max plan" to "Pro is all you need" .. so you either don't really know what's going on behind the scenes or you just repeat after some other content creator that hyped the repo for content reasons.

First visit to this channel via algorithm - verdict: no sub recommend.

top_reply.text: How could reading your entire codebase reduce your token usage, the entire premise of the pitch is completely flawed.
